title: LB Omnichord shared musical riff catalogue

design_contract.timing_rule: 96 PPQ independent phrases; never derive from bass activities
design_contract.eligibility_rule: Exact rhythm ID and chord suffix; scale metadata describes stable tones and never forces APG/LDR quantization
design_contract.selection_rule: Filter exact rhythm/chord compatibility; activity_rank denotes relative intensity. Preserve compatible ID at same rank; otherwise highest selection_weight then lowest index at target rank. Five ranks, not five expanded rows per context.
design_contract.copyright_rule: New theory-derived arrangements, no copied commercial bass lines

sources.title: StudyBass — Chromatic Approach Notes
sources.use: Semitone approach resolves directly into a structural target; not an arbitrary out-of-key note.

sources.title: MalletJazz — Constructing Walking Bass Lines
sources.use: Chord targets connected by scale motion and approaches.

sources.title: StudyBass — The Boogie-Woogie Blues Pattern
sources.use: Boogie contour; sixth and seventh must fit the actual chord.

sources.title: StudyBass — Root, Fifth, and Sixth
sources.use: Sixth colour in soul and funk, used only with compatible harmony.

sources.title: Yamaha — Authentic Bass Playing
sources.use: Genre articulation, space, root/fifth support and melodic variation.

sources.title: TalkingBass — Funky Bass Riff Rhythm
sources.use: Sixteenth-note syncopation and contrasting note lengths.

sources.title: TalkingBass — Bossa Nova Bass Lines
sources.use: Bossa groove context, not a transcription of a song.

sources.title: Joe Hubbard — The BIG 5 Brazilian Bass Grooves
sources.use: Dotted-eighth/sixteenth samba pulse and bossa relationship.

sources.title: Playmontuno — How to play bass tumbao
sources.use: Anticipated root and fifth; preserve rests across the downbeat.

sources.title: Ernesto Martin — How to Play Cumbia Bass
sources.use: Root/fifth register alternation and staccato ornamentation.

sources.title: StudyBass — Rhythmic Weight
sources.use: Compound pulse and explicitly grouped odd meter.

sources.title: Roland — Mastering the TB-303 Sequencer
sources.use: Pitch, time, accents and slides are separate phrase dimensions.

sources.title: Roland — Beyond Acid
sources.use: 303 sound design beyond acid; does not establish traditional 303 use in every genre.

sources.title: Andrew Olney — TB-303, Computational Thinking through Modular Sound Synthesis
sources.use: Slide gate continuity and accent/envelope interaction.
